task.title: P6-167: Stop MoveSelection's suggested resource from refiring on every checkbox toggle
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 8 — Performance). Original id: P6-167. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**`MoveSelection`'s `suggested` resource re-fires on every checkbox toggle even with the picker closed** (was `P6-061c` + `P6-061k`), and the server side is one sequential `suggested_destinations` query per oracle (`move_selection.rs:544-563`, `lib.rs:1211-1227`). A set-based query and/or gating on picker-open fixes it — gating alone introduces a re-render race where the test clicks. Fold in the sibling waste: two independent `list_collections` resources are live whenever the catalog picker and the tray are both mounted (`destination.rs:353`, `move_selection.rs:565-568`).
